name: memory-vault-client
description: Full authorized client for the open memory protocol: MCP, visible-turn capture, queued signed sync, host adapters and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Private memory network, sync and recovery
interface.longDescription: One open protocol with two equal usage paths: independent protocol adoption or this authorized full client. Restores v0.21 workflows with local retrieval and graph views, old host-wire adapters, visible-turn capture, resumable signed sync, complete client recovery, old packs, selective sharing and independently controlled verified updates. No Task/Git ownership, transcript discovery, permission creation, key auto-enrollment or log suppression. Development version: runtime validation, Work automatic lifecycle and production signing/encryption provisioning are not claimed.
capabilities: Direct protocol and portable bundle access
Controlled signed updates and reversible activation
Native private storage with explicit platform limits
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant memory before this work.
